# Archery at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's Team

The women's team archery event at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London was held at Lord's Cricket Ground on **29 July 2012**. It was the first medal event of the London Olympics.

## Format
- Each team consisted of three archers
- Teams shot from 70 meters
- Ranking round scores from earlier (held on 27 July) determined seeding
- Knockout format: 24 arrows per match (each archer shooting 8 arrows in 4 ends of 2 arrows each per archer, with team rotations)

## Medal Results

**Gold: South Korea** 🥇
- Ki Bo-bae
- Lee Sung-jin
- Choi Hyeon-ju

**Silver: China** 🥈
- Cheng Ming
- Fang Yuting
- Xu Jing

**Bronze: Japan** 🥉
- Kawanaka Kaori
- Hayakawa Ren
- Hon Miki

## Key Details

- South Korea defeated China **210–209** in a very close gold medal final
- This was South Korea's **seventh consecutive Olympic gold medal** in the women's team event (a streak dating back to 1988 when the event was introduced)
- Japan defeated Russia **209–207** in the bronze medal match
- Japan's bronze was historically significant as it was the country's first Olympic medal in women's team archery

## Ranking Round
South Korea set a new world record in the ranking round with a combined score of 1993 points, with Ki Bo-bae individually setting a world record of 671 points.

## Participating Teams
Eight teams competed (after the ranking round determined the top 8 for elimination): South Korea, China, Japan, Russia, India, Mexico, United Kingdom, and Italy among the participants.

South Korea's dominance in this event remained intact, continuing one of the most remarkable winning streaks in Olympic history.
